description: Search the documents of Annalist for a question in words, as ChatGPT connectors and deep research do: the overview, key findings, statements and ratios of the companies that the question names, or the overviews of the companies of an industry or sector it names. Returns ids for fetch, titles and the address of each page. The company ids of the other tools come from search_companies.

query.description: the question or keywords, for example Apple revenue growth or semiconductor margins

name: search
title: Search documents
